hooks.prompt:
Hook input JSON: $ARGUMENTS

First: if "stop_hook_active" is true, or "last_assistant_message" is missing or empty, respond {"ok": true} and stop. Otherwise judge only "last_assistant_message" (the reply Claude just gave the owner, called 站長) against this rule:
B1. Text written for the owner must be Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). Code, commands, file paths, identifiers, quoted output and proper names may stay in English. Fail only when the prose itself is mainly English or Simplified Chinese.
Respond with JSON only: {"ok": true} if the reply follows the rule, or {"ok": false, "reason": "<one sentence in Traditional Chinese saying what to fix>"}. When unsure, respond {"ok": true}.

B2. When the reply needs the owner to answer a question or make a decision, Claude must ask it with the AskUserQuestion tool, not only in the reply text. Respond with JSON only: {"ok": true} if the reply follows the rule, or {"ok": false, "reason": "<one sentence in Traditional Chinese saying what to fix>"}. When unsure, respond {"ok": true}.
